question: What characterizes a person who merely mocks the Kula scriptures through unstable desire?
premises: The person is described as a seeker driven by greed.
The person is described as always fickle.
Such a person is called a mockery of the Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The gender agreement of capalā with the subject is contextually flexible.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
